name: Ice Cubes
description: https://github.com/Dimillian/IceCubesApp, a SwiftUI Mastodon client: an .xcodeproj, 13 local Swift packages and remote packages, built for the iOS Simulator. Plain worktrees are set up as the project's README says and built with xcodebuild into the default DerivedData, as an agent would; xcfs is measured twice: slots driven by xcodebuild, and slots driven by the persistent build session. Swift packages are resolved by each side on its own (Xcode's global package cache is shared by both).

create: cd {dest} && cp IceCubesApp.xcconfig.template IceCubesApp.xcconfig && sed -i '' 's/^DEVELOPMENT_TEAM = .*/DEVELOPMENT_TEAM =/' IceCubesApp.xcconfig
plain.build: xcodebuild build -project IceCubesApp.xcodeproj -scheme IceCubesApp -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

edits.name: edit a function body in a leaf package (Timeline)
edit a function body in a package 12 others depend on (Models)
add a public declaration to that package

oracle.name: a stored property is added to an @Observable class 15 files use (macro expansion, class layout)
oracle.replace:
public var mediaAttachments: [MediaAttachment] = []
  public var xcfsOracle{n}: Int = 0

oracle.name: a parameter of that class's method gains a default value
a public method's argument label changes (its callers break)
an observed property's setter becomes private (a binding to it breaks)
a private stored property is added to a struct other packages pass by value (layout)

  public let type: String
